evidence.excerpt: We introduce PowerMarketJax, a benchmark suite for MARL across five power markets: day-ahead wholesale, real-time balancing, ancillary services, peer-to-peer double auctions, and local flexibility.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: PowerMarketJax implements both market simulation and policy training in JAX, allowing the entire pipeline to run on the GPU with 1,024 X 1,200 parallelisms across both environments and market participants, achieving up to 33X speedup over CPU-based baselines.
